title: Riding Without a Helmet
description: Riding or driving a two-wheeler without a protective helmet conforming to BIS standards. Carries an additional penalty of 3-month driver's licence disqualification.

title: Driving Without a Valid Licence
description: Operating a motor vehicle on public roads without holding an active, valid driving licence. May also involve community service or vehicle impoundment.

title: Driving Under the Influence (DUI / Drunk Driving)
description: Driving with blood alcohol content exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml of blood. First offence attracts fine up to ₹10,000 and/or imprisonment up to 6 months.

title: Driving Without Pollution Under Control Certificate (PUCC)
description: Operating a motor vehicle violating environmental standards or lacking a valid PUCC. Also punishable with licence suspension for up to 3 months.

title: Public Nuisance
description: Doing an act causing common injury, danger, or annoyance to the public or people in the vicinity.

title: Theft Penalties
baseFine: Discretionary fine + Imprisonment up to 3 years
description: Dishonestly taking moveable property out of the possession of any person without consent.
